'''Fitre''' was a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Fitre had a broad knowledge of beverages and was employed as a bartender in the [[Fungus Pit]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Fitre was present in the cantina when it was attacked by a group of [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].
